The literal IDs without '#' DO appear (1x each, plus runtime injection). This is functionally correct — flagging only as a discrepancy with the review-request grep expectation, not a code defect.
All required data-testid attributes present: uitg-merken-teaser, uitg-az-<letter> (27x), merken-back-btn.
